specs.derived_from: HK listing fails or PE redemptions drain parent cash before listing
specs.rationale: Untestable: 'HK listing fails' is a discrete event, not a metric. The measurable leg (parent cash drained) cannot be honestly typed to a single source_hint: cash routinely reclassifies into short-term investments (corrections.md XC-6a: cash fell 128.4 -> 57.9 USD millions while STI went 0 -> 65.4 on offering-proceeds reclassification), and the resolver reads exactly one concept, so a cash-only threshold would fire on reclassification rather than drain.
